packages.title: 2 Days Safari to Ruaha National Park
packages.summary: The 2 Days Safari flying to Ruaha National Park will give you a memorable adventure in this great remote wilderness of Ruaha that gives you an opportunity to discover the diverse intriguing ecosystem of untamed wildlife, nature and the great Ruaha River while you experience the wild and unique adventure.

heroImage.alt: 2 Days Safari to Ruaha National Park

gallery.alt: 2 Days Safari to Ruaha National Park
2 Days Safari to Ruaha National Park

itinerary.title: Transfer to Ruaha National Park
itinerary.summary: In the morning after you’ve enjoyed your breakfast, you will be driven to Ruaha national park from Iringa town by road taking 2 hours through unwinding beautiful landscapes or you can fly from Dar es salaam using a schedule chartered flight, on reaching the park you will head for a game drive to watch wild animals like herds of elephants buffalo lesser and greater kudus, impalas, waterbucks, bushbucks, hartebeest, jackals, and many others. Ruaha National Park has large concentration of wildlife including lions, cheetahs, leopards as well as stripped hyenas and also you will have chances to watch the African wild dogs. Return for overnight and dinner at your booked accommodation.

itinerary.title: Ruaha Morning Game Drive and Departure
itinerary.summary: On second day you will go for a sunrise game drive around the park, at unique sandy rivers (waterholes) and along the Ruaha river banks that usually attract a higher concentration of wildlife, with breakfast in the bush expect to spot the park predators such as lions, cheetahs, leopards, wild dogs, hyenas, jackals and view numerous bird species till lunchtime, return to the lodge for your refilling lunch before setting off for your drive back to Iringa or flay back to Dar es Salaam.

packages.title: 5 Days Safari to Mikumi & Ruaha National Parks
packages.summary: This 5 Day Safari you will visit Mikumi & Ruaha National Parks that lies deep in the South with its striking, rugged landscapes and abundant wildlife. The great Ruaha River provides life to the park, flows through the eastern side of the park and is home to hippos, crocodiles and the bird count is over 400 species of birds such as Racket Tailed Roller, Pale-billed Hornbill, Shelley’s Sunbird and Hoopoes. Ruaha providing home to one of Tanzania's largest elephant populations, famous for pride of lions, giraffe, grant's gazelles, Leopard, Cheetah, Zebra, Giraffe, Buffalo etc and rare or endangered animals such as Sable Antelope, Greater Kudu & Roan Antelope. This journey promises the best that Southern Tanzania has to offer with an amazing selection of iconic parks and reserves for you to experience of game drive, historical sites & walking safari.

packages.title: 4 Days Safari to Mikumi & Udzungwa National Parks
packages.summary:
This 4 Days safari to Udzungwa and Mikumi is ideal safari for the experience Game Safari & Hiking. The Udzungwa Mountains National Park is a sumptuous forested reserve, a rare tropical forest that is home to a realm of unique plants, birds and animals & the sacred preserve of hikers and walkers. The park is a home of an important population of primates (10 species- more than in any of Tanzania’s other parks) as well as the grey faced sengi.

Mikumi’s landscape provides a serene wildlife experience, commonly seen animals like Impalas, Elephants, Giraffes, Zebras, Antelopes, Wildebeests, Elands, Crocodiles, Hippos, Baboons. If luck is in your favor, you won’t miss to see Lions and Leopard. Mikumi inhabits over 300 species of birds namely saddle bill stork, hammer kop, malachite kingfisher, lilac breasted roller, yellow throated long claw, battler eagle etc.

packages.title: Day Trip to Mikumi National Park
packages.summary:
A day trip to Mikumi National Park from Dar es Salaam, this is a shortest safari offered in the southern Tanzania (Day safari to Tanzania). Day Trip Mikumi National Park (Safari from Dar es Salaam) takes you to one of the closest park in the south called Mikumi National Park. It starts very early in the morning around 0330 hours and ends after 2000 hours back into Dar es Salaam.

The park is well-known for its population of elephants, impalas, giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, elands, wildebeest, roan and sable antelope. Predators include tree-climbing lions, leopards, wild hunting dogs and black-backed jackal. More than 300 species of birds have been recorded including Eurasian migrants such as red billed oxpecker, marabou stork and lilac breasted roller.

packages.title: 3 Days Safari to Udzungwa & Mikumi National Parks
packages.summary:
This 3 Days safari to Udzungwa and Mikumi is ideal safari for the experience Game Safari & Hiking. The Udzungwa Mountains National Park is a sumptuous forested reserve, a rare tropical forest that is home to a realm of unique plants, birds and animals & the sacred preserve of hikers and walkers. The park is a home of an important population of primates (10 species- more than in any of Tanzania’s other parks) as well as the grey faced sengi.

Mikumi’s landscape provides a serene wildlife experience, commonly seen animals like Impalas, Elephants, Giraffes, Zebras, Antelopes, Wildebeests, Elands, Crocodiles, Hippos, Baboons. If luck is in your favor, you won’t miss to see Lions and Leopard. Mikumi inhabits over 300 species of birds namely saddle bill stork, hammer kop, malachite kingfisher, lilac breasted roller, yellow throated long claw, battler eagle etc.

packages.title: 3 Days Safari to Nyerere and Mikumi National Parks
packages.summary:
This 3 Days safari to Nyerere (Selous) and Mikumi is ideal short safari on the Tanzania Southern Circuit. Nyerere Park size is stunning, bigger than Switzerland or Denmark, uninhabited and little touched by human interference. Visitors, therefore, find themselves in a pristine wilderness far away from the trodden tourist routes. Its wildlife (including some few remaining Black rhinos and Wild dogs) are very spectacular.

Mikumi’s landscape provides a serene wildlife experience, commonly seen animals like Impalas, Elephants, Giraffes, Zebras, Antelopes, Wildebeests, Elands, Crocodiles, Hippos, Baboons. If luck is in your favor, you won’t miss to see Lions and Leopard. Mikumi inhabits over 300 species of birds namely saddle bill stork, hammer kop, malachite kingfisher, lilac breasted roller, yellow throated long claw, battler eagle etc.

itinerary.title: Zanzibar / Dar es Salaam - Nyerere National Park (Selous)
itinerary.summary: Take early in the morning flight from Zanzibar / Dar es Salaam to Nyerere National Park (Selous), picked up at Mtemere Airstrip then set off for game drive. Nyerere Park is known as home of wild dog and lions, leopard and many more animals. Lunch will be saved in bush and thereafter we will proceed with game drive till evening when we drive back to Lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Nyerere National Park (Selous) – Mikumi National Park
itinerary.summary: Early in the morning breakfast at lodge and departure to Mikumi national park. Driving takes up to 7 hours due of lough road. Will have hot lunch at Morogoro Town and proceed with journey until we get at Mikumi national park. Will do evening game drive and drive back to hotel for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Mikumi National Park - Dar Salaam / Zanzibar
itinerary.summary: Wake up early in the morning with breakfast and lunch boxes which will be saved in Bush as breakfast and lunch on the way to Dar Salaam. We will start with a short game drive then drive out the park around 10:30 am and drive back to Dar Salaam for catch up boat to Zanzibar which takes about 4 to 5 hours driving from Mikumi National Park.

You will have plenty of time for extensive animal watching, river boating and the opportunity to shoot many great photos. You are in the center of attention and you are invited to shape with us the daily schedule of your safari.

itinerary.title: Dar es Salaam - Nyerere National Park
itinerary.summary: After breakfast drive to Nyerere National Park, with packed lunch en route. In the evening you will do boat safari then head to lodge for dinner and overnight. With an area of around 50,000sq km (5% of Tanzania’s land surface) Nyerere National Park is one of the large protected areas in the world.

itinerary.title: Full day Nyerere National Park
itinerary.summary: Today you will have a full day of game drive mixed with walking safari with a guide in Nyerere National Park, with picnic lunch (if interested can still enjoy the sunset Boat tour) . In the late afternoon, you will return to the lodge for dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Nyerere National Park - Mikumi National Park
itinerary.summary: After early breakfast depart with picnic lunch and drive to Mikumi National park across the beautiful Uluguru Mountains, enjoying people and culture. Dinner and overnight will be at Mikumi. With an area of about 3230km (Tanzania’s 4th largest Park); Mikumi is one of the most popular parks for both tourists and local people.

itinerary.title: Mikumi National Park - Dar es Salaam
itinerary.summary: After breakfast drive back to Dar es Salam or fly to Zanzibar for your departure flight.

packages.title: 2 Days to Udzungwa Mountains National Park
packages.summary: A 2 Days Udzungwa Mountains National Park Safari will take you from Dar es Salaam to Udzungwa via Morogoro. Udzungwa Mountains are rich with uniqueness in nature and wildlife, you will be able to visit the magnificent Sanje waterfalls, trek the endangered Udzungwa primates which will give an exceptional adventure experience.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Udzungwa National Park
itinerary.summary: Today you will be picked from your hotel in Dar es Salaam / Morogoro for a journey to Udzungwa mountains national park an upon your arrival you will go for a hike to the fantastic waterfalls with magnificent views, the waterfalls have good clean water which gives a chance for swimming cooling from the whole tiring hike, you may be able to see some primates and mammals creating a tremendous adventure, return back to the headquarters and overnight will be camping in the park which is also a whole different unique experience.

itinerary.title: Udzungwa National Park – Morogoro / Dar es Salaam
itinerary.summary: On this day after getting breakfast, you will head back to the mountain forests for trekking the rare endangered monkey species also known as Red Colobus Monkey and the Sanje Crested Mangabey, you will also be able to see some other common monkeys like blue & velvet monkeys, also encounters with some small mammals, watch a variety of birds, butterflies and return back for lunch before setting off back to Morogoro / Dar es Salaam.
